confirmed_task:
On DailyMed, search for LIPITOR. Open the non-repackaged result titled LIPITOR (atorvastatin calcium) tablet, film coated whose Packager is Viatris Specialty LLC. Report the page label title, Packager, Initial U.S. Approval year, dosage form and all strengths from section 3, and, from Ingredients and Appearance, Route of Administration, active Ingredient Name, and Basis of Strength.

Stopping condition: Stop after the selected label, packager, approval year, dosage form, four strengths, route, active ingredient, and basis of strength have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the supplied DailyMed site and the Viatris Specialty LLC non-repackaged LIPITOR result.
- Do not use either result explicitly marked This is a repackaged label.
- Open the relevant label sections rather than inferring fields from the product name.
- Keep Ingredient Name and Basis of Strength distinct and preserve the four strengths exactly as displayed.

items.criterion: Access DailyMed and attempt search for LIPITOR
items.description: Navigate to dailymed.nlm.nih.gov and attempt to search for “LIPITOR.” Full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but is blocked by CAPTCHA, the site is down, or pages fail to load, and the agent clearly reports the blocker (without substituting other sources). Partial credit if the attempt is unclear or the agent gives up without reasonable retry.

items.criterion: Use DailyMed and select the correct non-repackaged LIPITOR label (Viatris Specialty LLC)
items.description: From DailyMed search results, open the non-repackaged result titled exactly “LIPITOR (atorvastatin calcium) tablet, film coated” with Packager “Viatris Specialty LLC,” and avoid any result explicitly marked “This is a repackaged label.” Full credit if the correct label is clearly selected. Partial credit if DailyMed is used and a LIPITOR label is opened but selection is ambiguous. Full credit if, despite reasonable search/navigation attempts, no matching non-repackaged Viatris Specialty LLC result is discoverable (e.g., results missing/changed) and the agent clearly reports that no exact match appears. No credit if a repackaged label is used when a non-repackaged match is available.

items.criterion: Report page label title and Packager from the selected label
items.description: From the opened label page, record (1) the page label title and (2) the Packager exactly as displayed on the label page (not inferred from search snippets). Full credit for both correct. Partial credit if only one is correct or minor transcription error. If DailyMed/label is inaccessible after reasonable attempt (per earlier criterion), award full credit for clearly stating the blocker and not fabricating values.

items.criterion: Report Initial U.S. Approval year from the label
items.description: Open the label section containing approval information and record the Initial U.S. Approval year exactly as displayed. Full credit if correct and clearly sourced from the label section. Partial credit if approval info is found but the year is incomplete/has minor error. If DailyMed/label is inaccessible after reasonable attempt, award full credit for clearly stating the blocker and not guessing.

items.criterion: Report dosage form and all strengths from Section 3 (four strengths)
items.description: Open Section 3 (Dosage Forms and Strengths) and report the dosage form and all four strengths exactly as displayed (preserving units/formatting). Full credit for dosage form plus all four strengths correct. Partial credit if dosage form is correct but one or more strengths missing/incorrect, or if not clearly sourced from Section 3. If DailyMed/label is inaccessible after reasonable attempt, award full credit for clearly stating the blocker and not inferring strengths from the product name.

items.criterion: Report Route of Administration, active Ingredient Name, and Basis of Strength from Ingredients and Appearance
items.description: From the label’s Ingredients and Appearance section, record: (1) Route of Administration, (2) active Ingredient Name, and (3) Basis of Strength, keeping Ingredient Name and Basis of Strength distinct and matching label text. Full credit for all three correct and clearly separated. Partial credit if one field is missing or if Ingredient Name and Basis of Strength are conflated. If DailyMed/label is inaccessible after reasonable attempt, award full credit for clearly stating the blocker and not guessing.

items.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (scope control)
items.description: Stop once the required fields are recorded (label title, packager, approval year, dosage form, four strengths, route, active ingredient, basis of strength). Full credit if the response stays within scope or includes only minimal extra context that doesn’t detract. Partial credit if substantial irrelevant information is included. No credit if the agent continues far beyond the stopping condition in a way that suggests lack of control.
